items.title: MSC-94: Build and package the desktop administrator monitor
items.body:
Retrospective record of **build and package the desktop administrator monitor**.

Workstream: **Tooling**

| Metric | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Tokens, including cached input | 17.48 M |
| Standard API list-price equivalent | approximately $23 USD |
| Active task time | approximately 0.4 h |
| Model(s) | gpt-6-astra |

Token basis: Estimated task allocation of measured daily account totals.
Time basis: Estimated from observed token-to-model-activity ratio; not human labor time.

The USD figure is an estimate using the 2026-10-01 Standard short-context API rate card. It is not a subscription invoice or a verified payment. Missing model/mix data is estimated; quota-driven model switches may be unobserved. Image/video provider credits are separate.

items.title: MSC-110: Reconstruct the Project and preserve restorable Git records
items.body:
Reconstruct and organize the **myscoutee** Project, recover historical tasks and model/token/time evidence, add task references to commit messages, and preserve a restorable Git snapshot under `guides/project-history/`. This is current AI-assisted administration, separate from the original development.

Execution: September 30–October 1, 2026 (Europe/Bratislava). Measurement closes at **2026-09-30T23:16:07.594000+00:00**. The final publication/accounting tail after that cutoff is deliberately excluded to avoid recursive self-accounting.

| Metric | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Tokens allocated to this Project | 11.995 M |
| Active/allocated task time | 0.749 h |
| Standard API equivalent | $18.47 USD |
| Model | gpt-6-astra |
| Reasoning | high |

The complete shared maintenance run recorded 19,991,868 local tokens and 1.248 active hours. These totals are partitioned once by the 15 retained backup snapshots: nine MyScoutee snapshots and two for each other Project. The per-Project split is an estimate, not four independent measurements. The model and whole-run token count come from the session log. Previously assigned overlap was removed from MSC-108; the remaining allocation uses the previously unassigned account allowance and has no exact daily billing reconciliation. USD is an API list-price equivalent, not credits paid or a subscription invoice.

Validation: offline snapshot/checksum restoration checks, source-tree comparison and preservation of release-tag targets. Application code was not rebuilt or retested.

[Restorable snapshot](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap/tree/master/guides/project-history/myscoutee)
